gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis: Newly diagnosed supratentorial glioblastoma according to the 2021 World Health Organization (WHO) Classification of Central Nervous System Tumors

candidate_evidence.quote: to explore the efficacy of the add-on of the anti-glutamatergic drugs gabapentin, sulfasalazine and memantine to standard chemoradiotherapy with temozolomide compared to chemoradiotherapy alone in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Diagnosis: Newly diagnosed supratentorial glioblastoma according to the 2021 World Health Organization (WHO) Classification of Central Nervous System Tumors

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Tumor glutamate levels: determined by MRI spectroscopy

role_evidence.quote: Radiotherapy 30 x 2 Gy with concomitant temozolomide followed by maintenance temozolomide plus combined daily gabapentin, sulfasalazine and memantine

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: the anti-epileptic drug gabapentin, which is a potent inhibitor of the critical glutamate synthesis enzyme branched chain amino acid transaminase 1 (BCAT-1)
arms: Standard of care plus glutamate signaling inhibitors

role_evidence.quote: Radiotherapy 30 x 2 Gy with concomitant temozolomide followed by maintenance temozolomide plus combined daily gabapentin, sulfasalazine and memantine

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: the anti-inflammatory drug sulfasalazine, which is a potent inhibitor of glutamate secretion by blocking the cystine-glutamate exchanger system Xc
arms: Standard of care plus glutamate signaling inhibitors

role_evidence.quote: Radiotherapy 30 x 2 Gy with concomitant temozolomide followed by maintenance temozolomide plus combined daily gabapentin, sulfasalazine and memantine

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: the cognitive enhancer memantine, which can prevent glutamate-driven, calcium-induced neuronal death and tumor cell invasion by blocking N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) type glutamate receptors
arms: Standard of care plus glutamate signaling inhibitors

role_evidence.quote: [ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Standard of care: Radiotherapy 30 x 2 Gy with concomitant temozolomide followed by maintenance temozolomide

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care
arms: Standard of care plus glutamate signaling inhibitors

source_quote.quote: PFS compared between subgroups segregated by baseline parameters including age, extent of resection, KPS, MGMT promotor methylation status
exploratory analyses of outcome among molecular glioblastoma subtypes determined by methylome and gene panel sequencing

coder_notes: Three repurposed anti-glutamatergic drugs added to Stupp; each experimental_combination. Target engagement coded yes for tumour glutamate on MR spectroscopy (pharmacodynamic readout of the glutamate-targeting regimen); not listed as a molecular biomarker because it is imaging-based and not described as a biomarker. 'IDH wild-type' appears only in keywords; eligibility cites WHO 2021 (cns5). Control is the registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR arm.
